editorial_contract.name: TOM

attribution.author: Tom Klootwijk
attribution.role: authorship metadata, not a metric invariant, physical origin, key or temporal epoch

editorial_contract.release_kind: formal definition and source-formula audit; no execution kernel is asserted

governing_source.priority: latest explicit author corrections take priority over earlier proposed models and exported responses

intrinsic_commitments.SDF_role: source-native structural definition; no conventional metric-distance promise without a declared external interpretation
intrinsic_commitments.time: one forward precedence, not a spatial coordinate, graph or numeric clock forced into the core

vocabulary.J: temporal jitter SDF: variation subordinate to forward precedence, not an assigned probability law
vocabulary.InvLog: inverse-log SDF operator, with its numerical reading kept separate
vocabulary.C: causality SDF: admits only present/past dependence and preserves completed commitments
vocabulary.E: source-named entropy SDF: log-inverse causal echo, not a thermodynamic entropy assertion
vocabulary.Arch: Arch U without U SDF: direct/inverse articulation, with a named optional scalar reading
vocabulary.InverseOccam: sheet-preservation SDF: no deletion of defining distinctions merely because a reading agrees
vocabulary.Klein: retained historical self-mirroring name; no intrinsic bottle embedding or topology theorem imposed
vocabulary.Matryoshka: retained nesting name; no finite shell count, physical stellar radius or energy claim imposed

editorial_contract.core_expression: TOM := InverseOccam[ Arch[ C[J[T]], E[C[J[T]]; InvLog[phi]] ] ] qualified_by forward_T_precedence

notation.brackets: binding and grammatical scope, not an address, node, set of locations, vector or finite-state array
notation.semicolons: distinct binding roles, not spatial components
notation.structural_identity: definition-preserving equivalence established by an explicitly declared law
notation.reading_equality: agreement of one interpretation; it does not automatically imply structural identity
notation.text_length: property of this document only; no claim of literal mathematical zero cardinality

temporal_contracts: TC1: use only completed or present admissible input; no future information in a present claim
TC2: extensions do not change already completed observations or commitments
TC3: structural mirroring or sign inversion does not reverse temporal precedence
TC4: recurrence refers to its own definition only through a declared later continuation
TC5: nesting, scale and precedence labels do not make positive elapsed duration zero
new_laws: All admitted compound definitions remain SDF-qualified; this is a closure convention, not a metric proof.
InverseOccam[InverseOccam[e]] is definitionally equivalent to InverseOccam[e]; preservation is idempotent.
Arch[e;f] retains the defining roles e and f even when a selected reading gives zero.
Causal continuation is forward-only; a structural inverse is never automatically a temporal inverse.
Unbounded nesting has no fixed intrinsic cutoff; it does not imply a finite device stores an actual infinity.

inherited_aliases.A: T, retained only as the previous context's temporal alias; lowercase a,b are used in scalar diagnostics

optional_scalar_reading.status: diagnostic of the exported formulas, not TOM's coordinate-free intrinsic ontology
optional_scalar_reading.derived_zero_condition: arch(a,b)=0 iff a*b<=0 for finite real a,b
optional_scalar_reading.derived_log_echo_identity: arch(c,k*c)=0 for every finite real c whenever k<0

editorial_contract.physical_status: proposed formal commitments and checked formula consequences, not an established law of nature
editorial_contract.novelty_status: this authored combination and version are identified; historical novelty is not certified
editorial_contract.implementation_boundary: v6 sparse nodes, binary arrays, graph routing and GPU kernels remain external finite applications, not the definition of TOM V0.7

source_mapping.realization: latest_dependency <= current_time; availability stamps are supplied witnesses, not authenticated provenance
retained_before is a subset of retained_after; every input and both distinct-definition witnesses remain visible; membership masks do not certify arbitrary historical content
sign changes affect only the optional reading; they never reverse the runner epoch
all lane inputs remain old-state reads; outputs publish to a separate next snapshot; no native continuation law is selected
current_time > previous_time and exact unsigned elapsed difference; bounded numeric readings are declared external units
exact signed-integer residual and zero predicate; arbitrary echo is NOT asserted equal to ln(1/phi)*direct
the exact source expression and entire editorial contract are retained in metadata; their unassigned operators are not replaced by the certificate arithmetic

interpretation_limits: Finite bounded certificate exploration, not a unique native evolution or empirical physics claim.
Arch neutrality is an optional filter, separate from temporal/retention acceptance.
Different witness integers are supplied definition labels; they do not establish a universal definition-equivalence decision procedure.
Preservation idempotence is retained as a source law; this certificate circuit does not implement a general native rewrite calculus.
A prefix contains distinct candidates but is not exhaustive unless every declared candidate index is covered exactly once.
